Title: Janek Supply Line
Description: Secure the Janek supply corridor, protect a vital convoy and intercept the raiders behind the attacks.

Steps.Title: Janek: Silent Watch
Steps.Brief: Map the patrol corridor and identify threats to civilian traffic.

Steps.Title: Janek: Convoy Shield
Steps.Brief: Escort the convoy through the corridor secured by the preceding patrol.

Steps.Title: Janek: Broken Spear
Steps.Brief: Intercept the raider group identified during the convoy attack.

Title: Jarnell Convoy Watch
Description: Protect Jarnell shipping and break up the force hunting its freighters.

Steps.Title: Jarnell: Convoy Shield
Steps.Brief: Keep the convoy intact and report the hostile approach vector.

Steps.Title: Jarnell: Broken Spear
Steps.Brief: Use the convoy report to intercept the raiders before their next attack.

Title: Iron Vigil
Description: Defend Marak against intruders through patrol and interception.

Steps.Title: Marak: Silent Watch
Steps.Brief: Establish a patrol picture around Marak and report unauthorized ships.

Steps.Title: Marak: Broken Spear
Steps.Brief: Intercept the hostile force identified by the patrol.

Title: Loris Border Watch
Description: Reassert control of the Loris border shipping lanes.

Steps.Title: Loris: Silent Watch
Steps.Brief: Patrol the border lanes and confirm the intrusion.

Steps.Title: Loris: Broken Spear
Steps.Brief: Respond to the patrol report and intercept the intruding force.

Title: Haiche Safe Passage
Description: Defend local commerce while tracing the source of attacks.

Steps.Title: Haiche: Convoy Shield
Steps.Brief: Escort the threatened freighters and collect the attack report.

Steps.Title: Haiche: Broken Spear
Steps.Brief: Intercept the force exposed by the convoy encounter.

Title: Silessia Trade Guard
Description: Survey the Silessia trade lanes before committing to convoy protection.

Steps.Title: Silessia: Silent Watch
Steps.Brief: Patrol the trade approaches and clear the route for the next convoy.

Steps.Title: Silessia: Convoy Shield
Steps.Brief: Escort the convoy through the surveyed trade corridor.
